# Gabe Velez - Senior Product Designer That Ships

> Portfolio of Gabe Velez, a Senior Product Designer based in Queens, New York
> who builds what he designs. Ticketing platforms, design systems, and B2B
> analytics. Over 10 years of shipping real products.

## Case Studies

- [NYCNewYears.com Site Overhaul](https://gabevelez.com/case-studies/nycnewyears-dot-com-site-overhaul.html): Ground-up rebuild of a flagship New Year's Eve ticketing site, cutting code 48%. In its first full season, sessions ran 36% longer and visitors viewed 21% more pages per visit.
- [AfterPromCentral Events Calendar](https://gabevelez.com/case-studies/afterpromcentral-events-calendar.html): Custom WordPress calendar plugin built in under 3 months that removed content errors and boosted conversions for 20-30 seasonal events.
- [Integrate Design System Audit](https://gabevelez.com/case-studies/integrate-design-system-audit.html): Unified the design language of 3 acquired companies. Reduced colors 55% with WCAG accessibility throughout, delivered as Figma and Storybook libraries.
- [Integrate ABM Web Analytics](https://gabevelez.com/case-studies/integrate-abm-web-analytics.html): Account-level B2B web analytics dashboard built on existing pixel infrastructure, used by customers like Microsoft and Cloudflare.

## Side Projects

- [TokTix Event Ticketing App](https://gabevelez.com/side-projects/toktix-ticketing-platform.html): Two-sided event ticketing marketplace designed and engineered solo with AI-assisted development. Live on the App Store and Google Play, running an active pilot with a real event company.
